# Content tripwire terms: disclosure strings whose THREAT is the string itself
# appearing in prose. Filenames are NOT here; those are paths, and paths are
# scanned by .github/scripts/forbidden-paths.txt (an empty file still gets
# caught there). One case-insensitive extended-regex pattern per line;
# '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#
# NOT here, on purpose:
#   ADO / Azure DevOps / MBM: they have real homes (the ADO MCP Server card, the
#   employer string), so a blind grep cannot tell a regression from the real
#   thing.
#   Upside: "the upside is" is common prose and the word has never appeared in
#   this codebase, so scanning for it costs more than it protects. The
#   filename scan plus "private repo" carry the load.
